propositions: Build a committed one-time history-strip script using stock git plumbing (fast-export piped through a filter into fast-import) rather than git-filter-repo.
The script must preserve all commits, merge commits, and empty commits so DAG topology and file introduction points survive for ancestry-based authorship verification.
The rewritten branch's tree must be byte-identical to the old tip tree after dynamically re-adding the .bridge_state set discovered via ls-tree.
The strip must remove both .bridge_state/ and .bridge_state.bak-retarget/ prefixes from history, dropping pack size to <=15% of original.
The filter must be data-length-aware to avoid corrupting commit messages that begin with M or D, and must run in a fresh unfiltered clone, refusing to run in a blob:none partial clone.
The script must push only via --force-with-lease and run all assertions in a dry-run harness before any push, with no push step of its own.
